note: Regional park on Silver Lake about 15 km northeast of Maidstone, with a nine-hole golf course, a diked swimming area and a bird-viewing tower. Open sunny rows south of the ball diamonds and a wooded loop along the lake's east shore. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rates; 33 large sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Keep (local; posted nightly rates $25-50 plus tax, phone/email booking, Google 4.3/110). Nightly share not measurable (no site list); 33+ seasonal sites of 128 and spring imagery with most south-row sites occupied. Waterfront lead: a wooded loop on the east shore ~20-35 m from the lake behind a treed bank. Pin fine.
flags: LONG-STAY: regional park (local). 128 campsites; the park history says 'In 2008, 33 large seasonal sites were developed', and every serviced class has a seasonal price ($2,100 / $2,500). No site list or booking engine, so the nightly share can't be measured; pre-season imagery (bare trees) shows most of the south rows already holding units, which suggests a large seasonal share. Posted daily rates and a phone booking line pass test 2; no wording discourages nightly guests. Google 4.3 (110 reviews; the place also covers the golf course). Reviewer: may need the 'Mostly seasonal' line if a phone check puts nightly under half.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront' (evidence looked only at the south rows, 150-230 m from the lake) kept by default-down, but there is a second, wooded loop along the east shore north of the ball diamonds (units around 53.2293-53.2300,-109.2694) whose nearest units sit ~20-35 m from the waterline behind a treed bank. No site map or site numbers found and whether those sites are nightly is unknown, so no upgrade; at most 'lakeview' if photos show the lake through the trees.
BOOKING: platform phone (no online engine; no Let's Camp camp). Facebook page facebook.com/SLRPSask linked from the regional parks page.
FEES: new. Rates are plus tax (tax written included:false; the tax is not named). Entry $10/day kept in fees.note (the page doesn't say per vehicle). Family areas $150/$200.
PIN: no move. Stored 53.2262,-109.2691 sits on the south RV rows; the lakeside loop centre is about 53.2295,-109.2690 (~370 m north) - same campground, same entrance road, not a split.
PHONE: 306-893-2831 confirmed (Google, regional parks page); winter phone (780) 205-8030.
